title: Unnamed Suit 022
summary: Unnamed Suit 022 is a Suit within the Organization. He operates from Sutos Island, Aegean Sea, under Grier.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
This Suit was recruited by [[Grier]] following [[DeFoe]]'s removal from [[the Organization]]. {{Source|The Beautiful Trap}}

This Suit accompanied [[Grier]] in claiming [[Sutos Island]] under [[the Organization]]. Under this team of Suits, the people of Sutos were registered, and peace from civil war was brought to the island. Unnamed Suit 022 and his team were led into a trap by [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]]. This Suit invoked a [[Mindrone]] Titan to fight the two, and the team nearly overwhelmed the Foundation members. The fight was cut short by [[Dante Vale]] and Grier, who had reached a truce.{{source|Like Father, Unlike Son}}

full_text:
Unnamed Suit 022 is a Suit within the Organization. He operates from Sutos Island, Aegean Sea, under Grier.

== History ==
This Suit was recruited by Grier following DeFoe's removal from the Organization. [The Beautiful Trap]

This Suit accompanied Grier in claiming Sutos Island under the Organization. Under this team of Suits, the people of Sutos were registered, and peace from civil war was brought to the island. Unnamed Suit 022 and his team were led into a trap by Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill. This Suit invoked a Mindrone Titan to fight the two, and the team nearly overwhelmed the Foundation members. The fight was cut short by Dante Vale and Grier, who had reached a truce.[Like Father, Unlike Son]

== Abilities ==
Like most Suits, he was issued with the standard Organization Titans.

=== Bonded Titans ===
* Mindrone
